scientific_question: Does exact vanilla SLIM learn a transferable unseen-target response direction from pinned STRING embeddings, and can that direction improve a direct donor-transfer incumbent?

upstream_reproduction.bias: per-response-gene arithmetic mean over fit-target absolute log1p TS50000 pseudobulks
upstream_reproduction.pca: exact deterministic PCA score basis of Y-b with sklearn-equivalent column centering across response genes
upstream_reproduction.ridge: W = solve(G.T@G + lambda*I, G.T@(Y-b)) @ P @ inv(P.T@P + lambda*I)
upstream_reproduction.embedding: unaltered first and only 64 dimensions from the pinned STRING HDF5

target_split.eligible: exact-symbol intersection across all three source donor perturbation axes, excluding all 300 VCC targets and requiring a pinned STRING row
target_split.selection: first 600 targets under ascending SHA256 of UTF8 experiment-123-split-v1 NUL target, target as deterministic tie break
target_split.assignment: first 360 fit, next 120 tune, final 120 test in the frozen hash order

response_axis.base: exact-symbol intersection of all three source donor gene axes

source_data_representation.absolute_training_pseudobulk: maximum(b_ctrl + delta, 0) in project log1p TS50000 coordinates
source_data_representation.direct_incumbent: fit-only centered source target effects, median-fit-row-norm normalized per source, equally averaged over non-held source donors
source_data_representation.slim_centered_adaptation: the exact fitted pre-clipping centered SLIM term G@W@P_query.T, with the same fit-only source norm normalization
source_data_representation.exact_upstream_diagnostic: exact upstream predicted effect before subtracting the fit-target mean

hyperparameter_grid.blend: normalize incumbent and centered-SLIM rows independently, form (1-f)*incumbent_unit + f*slim_unit, renormalize to the incumbent row norm

selection.strict_outer_isolation: for held donor D, fit only source donors A and B
selection.inner_cells: A fit predicts B tune and B fit predicts A tune
selection.selection_metric: complete-gallery raw uncentered PDS delta versus the direct single-source incumbent
selection.eligibility: nonnegative PDS delta in both inner cells
selection.deployment_candidate: same selection rule over all six ordered source-donor tune transfer cells, using fit rows only for every fitted statistic

metrics.pds: official cosine retrieval midrank score over the complete frozen gallery; zero prediction row receives 0.5
metrics.top20_weighted_sign_precision: select ceil(0.20*G) genes by descending abs(prediction) with canonical response order tie break; weight sign correctness by abs(truth)
metrics.outer_aggregation: arithmetic mean over 120 test targets within donor, then equal arithmetic mean over three donors

target_pairing.operation: derange fit-target STRING rows within eight frozen STRING-norm bins; tune and test query embeddings remain real

gaussian_embedding.operation: replace fit, tune and test embeddings by one deterministic Gaussian table per draw, featurewise rescaled to the real fit-target embedding mean and standard deviation

nulls.comparison: observed nested source macro deltas are compared with each family independently

uncertainty.cluster_definition: connected components of reciprocal five-nearest-neighbor STRING cosine edges at similarity at least 0.80 on the frozen 120 test targets
uncertainty.resampling: sample frozen target clusters with replacement and apply the same target multiplicities to all three outer donors
